body: Phones now use Focus, Projects and More by default. More opens the remaining views and browser-local earlier/later order and shortcut visibility controls, with reset and all-hidden recovery. The combined 494-test full gate, release Chromium/WebKit navigation and motion, Chromium dialogs/card-layout and broad HTTPS smoke pass. Rebuilt/restarted the existing HTTPS app; all 32 assets, 25 prior resource versions, settings, certificate and instance/epoch are verified. The combined responsive suite retains a concurrent profile-header picker-width failure at 320px; dedicated navigation bounds pass. Evidence: progress/2026-10-04-compact-navigation.md. Physical-device and release acceptance remain open.
